听力学家对成人前庭平衡问题管理的观点

Perspectives of audiologists on the management of vestibular balance problems in adults.

中文摘要

探讨听力学家在前庭平衡问题（VBPs）评估和治疗中不断演变的作用，并确定他们对当前实践、障碍和服务发展机会的看法。 一项混合方法研究，包括在线调查和半结构化访谈。 来自21个国家的116名听力学家完成了调查（约旦[n=34]、澳大利亚[n=25]、英国[n=9]、新加坡和南非[各n=7]、美国[n=6]，以及其他15个国家[各n<5]）。九名参与者（澳大利亚[n=5]、约旦[n=3]和南非[n=1]）完成了后续访谈。 参与VBP评估的程度超过治疗，反映在更高的培训率、活动率和信心水平上。治疗提供较少，更常转诊给物理治疗师和耳鼻喉科医生。虽然大多数参与者认为VBP管理属于实践范围，但访谈结果显示角色认知存在跨国差异。主要障碍包括实践培训有限、治疗实施信心低、设备和新兴技术获取受限，以及系统性限制，如转诊路径不明确和报销不佳。 听力学家在VBP评估中的参与度仍高于治疗。需要解决结构化培训、角色清晰度和系统层面支持方面的差距，以使听力学家能够更多地参与多学科护理。

英文摘要

To explore the evolving role of audiologists in the assessment and treatment of vestibular balance problems (VBPs) and to identify their perspectives on current practices, barriers, and opportunities for service development. A mixed methods study comprising an online survey and semi-structured interviews. 116 audiologists from 21 countries completed the survey (Jordan [n = 34], Australia [n = 25], United Kingdom [n = 9], Singapore and South Africa [n = 7 each], the United States [n = 6], and 15 other countries [n < 5 each]). Nine participants (Australia [n = 5], Jordan [n = 3], and South Africa [n = 1]) completed follow-up interviews. Involvement in VBP assessment exceeded that in treatment, reflected in higher rates of training, activity, and confidence. Treatment was less commonly provided and more frequently referred to physiotherapists and ENTs. While most participants considered VBP management within scope of practice, interview findings revealed cross-country variation in role perception. Key barriers included limited practical training, low confidence in treatment delivery, restricted access to equipment and emerging technologies, and systemic constraints such as unclear referral pathways and poor reimbursement. Audiologists remain more engaged in assessment than treatment of VBP. Addressing gaps in structured training, role clarity, and system-level support is required to enable greater participation of audiologists in multidisciplinary care.
